description: Resume a sequence A/B test (nodeType action_ab_test) that already has a winner, for example one picked automatically before the user was sure. Clears the winner so contacts reaching the step are split across the variants again, keeps the results collected so far, and turns off automatic selection for this test: it keeps splitting until a winner is selected with select_ab_test_winner. Pass confirmLiveChange when the sequence is active.

abTestId.description: Sequence A/B test ID to resume

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

confirmLiveChange.description: Required as true when the sequence is active, because contacts reaching the step are split again from then on.

name: resume_ab_test
